name: Coolers Icehouse
description: Coolers Icehouse is a lively and welcoming venue in Lake Charles that offers a fun karaoke experience with a friendly atmosphere. Known for its great drinks, including popular daiquiris and cold beers, it features a sound system that enhances the singing experience. The venue is open daily, with options for drive-thru daiquiris and a casual environment perfect for hanging out with friends or family. The staff is friendly and attentive, making every visit enjoyable. Whether you're here for karaoke, food, or drinks, Coolers Icehouse stands out as a versatile spot for entertainment and relaxation.
